note: For compose.example.yaml on one machine. Roles: app = a process on the host that runs the pipeline; gateway = run inside the gateway's network namespace; team-probe = a throwaway container on the team network; inner-probe = a throwaway container on the inner (model) network; admin = a machine with internet access. See deploy/ai-egress/README.md for the commands. This plan does NOT claim the gateway cannot reach the internet: on one machine that takes rules on the host (see the README).

checks.why: the gateway reads the AI switch and data sheet from the reference server
the gateway reaches the model's front door
stand-in: shows the model's own port answers from inside, so blocked means blocked and not 'switched off'
something else on the team network cannot reach the model's front door
stand-in for the outside: shows the address answers from a machine that is allowed out
